Hi all —

Thanks for joining the interest list for our APAC office hours focused on production inference patterns (routing, batching, quantization tradeoffs). We want to make this a short, demo-heavy session with a 20–25 minute product walkthrough + 15 minute Q&A.

Two short windows that work on our side — please reply with your preferred option or suggest a concrete alternate time in SGT (UTC+8):

- Option A: Wed, 29 Sep 2027 — 08:00–08:45 SGT (early APAC-friendly slot)
- Option B: Wed, 29 Sep 2027 — 16:00–16:45 SGT (late APAC slot for EMEA overlap)

If neither works, add a suggested date/time and we’ll try to consolidate into one session. I’ve attached a draft agenda and a proposed runbook outline.

Agenda highlights (attached):
- 10 min: design patterns for low-latency inference
- 10 min: demo — Redwood Optimize + Dedicated routing policies
- 10 min: customer examples + Q&A

Quick asks: please CC any technical attendees you want present (system/infrastructure/lead engineers) so we can tailor the demo.

Thanks,
